description: This file defines the database access layer for a backend API using SQLAlchemy. It includes functions for initializing and disposing of the database engine, providing database sessions for FastAPI dependencies, and backward-compatible asyncpg-style database operations. It also defines the ORM base and handles configuration via environment variables.

classes.name: Base
classes.description: SQLAlchemy declarative base for ORM models.

methods.name: None init_db_engine()
methods.description: Initializes the SQLAlchemy engine and session factory based on DATABASE_URL, optionally creating all tables if the environment variable is set.

methods.name: None dispose_db_engine()
methods.description: Disposes of the SQLAlchemy engine and releases resources.

methods.name: Generator[Session,None,None] get_db()
methods.description: Provides a database session as a FastAPI dependency, ensuring it's closed after use.

methods.name: get_engine()
methods.description: Returns the global SQLAlchemy engine instance for direct use.

methods.name: Optional[Dict[str,Any]] fetch_one(sql: str, *params: Any)
methods.description: Fetches a single database record as a dictionary using asyncpg-style SQL and parameters, wrapped in an async function for compatibility.

methods.name: List[Dict[str,Any]] fetch_all(sql: str, *params: Any)
methods.description: Fetches all matching database records as a list of dictionaries, using asyncpg-style SQL.

methods.name: str execute(sql: str, *params: Any)
methods.description: Executes a SQL command (INSERT/UPDATE/DELETE) and returns a status string.

methods.name: List[str] execute_many(sql: str, param_sets: List[Tuple[Any, ...]])
methods.description: Executes the same SQL command multiple times with different parameters, returning a list of status strings.

methods.name: tuple _convert_asyncpg_placeholders(sql: str, params: tuple)
methods.description: Helper function that converts asyncpg-style placeholders ($1, $2) in SQL to SQLAlchemy named parameters.

ctags.name: execute_many
ctags.pattern: /^async def execute_many(sql: str, param_sets: List[Tuple[Any, ...]]) -> List[str]:$/

ctags.name: fetch_all
ctags.pattern: /^async def fetch_all(sql: str, *params: Any) -> List[Dict[str, Any]]:$/

ctags.name: fetch_one
ctags.pattern: /^async def fetch_one(sql: str, *params: Any) -> Optional[Dict[str, Any]]:$/
